observations: Photo 0 shows a black PlayStation console from above with the PlayStation logo centered; it sits on a white surface with power and other cables around it; the side profile shows three stepped layers.
Photo 1 shows the same black console with two game controllers resting on top, one white and one black; both appear to be DualShock-style controllers; cables are connected to the console.
No game discs, cases, or additional accessories are visible in either photo.
Watermarks read "POSTED ON JIJI" and "GIDEON OYEKANMI" across both photos.

No games, discs, or cases are visible in photo 0 or photo 1

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have hardware faults such as overheating, disc drive failure, or HDMI output issues
risks.proof: A video of the console booting to the home screen and running a game

risks.risk: Controllers may have stick drift, dead batteries, or sync failures
risks.proof: A video of both controllers connecting to the console and responding to button presses

risks.risk: The 14 games may not exist, may be blank or damaged discs, or may not be included
risks.proof: Clear photos of all 14 game cases or discs
risks.if_unproven: as console only with no games

risks.risk: Power cable or HDMI cable may be missing or the wrong regional type
risks.proof: A photo of all included cables and plugs

proof_requests: Clear photo of the console's rear label showing the model number
Video of the console powering on and displaying the home screen
Photos of all 14 game discs or cases
Video of both controllers connecting and being used
response.reason: The console appears to be a PlayStation 4 family unit but the specific model is not readable in the photos, and the model materially changes the price; a shot of the rear label is needed before even a worst-case price can be set.
